Statements.SQL: SELECT "foundry_challenges"."id" AS "id", "foundry_challenges"."subject_key" AS "subject_key" FROM "foundry_challenges" WHERE ("foundry_challenges"."scope" = $1) AND ("foundry_challenges"."expires_at" <= $2) ORDER BY "foundry_challenges"."subject_key" ASC, "foundry_challenges"."id" ASC LIMIT $3
